description: This file defines the `EmailsController` class, which manages email-related actions in the SuiteCRM platform, including composing, sending, importing, replying, forwarding, and managing email folders. It handles HTTP requests and orchestrates interactions with email beans, inbound and outbound email configurations, and UI views.

classes.name: EmailsController
classes.description: Controller class that manages email operations including composing, sending, importing, replying, folder management, and attachment handling within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: action_index
methods.description: Displays list view of emails.

methods.name: action_DetailDraftView
methods.description: Displays the draft email detail view.

methods.name: action_ComposeView
methods.description: Handles rendering the email compose view, including popup handling and setting up recipient fields.

methods.name: action_send
methods.description: Processes sending an email, including validation, handling outbound accounts, and updating email status.

methods.name: replaceEmailVariables
methods.description: Parses email templates and replaces variables with actual bean data.

methods.name: isValidRequestForReplaceEmailVariables
methods.description: Validates the request data before performing email variable replacements.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages at specified log level.

methods.name: action_SaveDraft
methods.description: Saves the current email as a draft.

methods.name: action_DeleteDraft
methods.description: Deletes a draft email.

methods.name: action_Popup
methods.description: Displays an email related popup.

methods.name: action_getFromFields
methods.description: Fetches 'from' field options including signatures.

methods.name: action_GetDraftAttachmentData
methods.description: Retrieves attachment data for a draft email.

methods.name: action_CheckEmail
methods.description: Triggers email inbox check and synchronization.

methods.name: action_GetFolders
methods.description: Retrieves email folders for display.

methods.name: action_DisplayDetailView
methods.description: Displays the detailed view of an email, either directly or after fetching from the database.

methods.name: action_ImportAndShowDetailView
methods.description: Imports email from inbound server and then shows detail view.

methods.name: action_ImportView
methods.description: Displays the email import view.

methods.name: action_GetCurrentUserID
methods.description: Returns the current user's ID.

methods.name: action_ImportFromListView
methods.description: Imports emails from a list view, supporting folder import.

methods.name: action_ReplyTo
methods.description: Prepares a reply email.

methods.name: action_ReplyToAll
methods.description: Prepares a reply-to-all email.

methods.name: action_Forward
methods.description: Prepares a forwarded email.

methods.name: action_ComposeViewWithPdfTemplate
methods.description: Loads compose view with PDF template content.

methods.name: action_SendDraft
methods.description: Sends the composed draft email.

methods.name: action_MarkEmails
methods.description: Marks emails with read/unread or other flags.

methods.name: action_DeleteFromImap
methods.description: Deletes specified emails from IMAP server.

methods.name: markEmails
methods.description: Helper to mark emails with flags on the mail server.

methods.name: composeBean
methods.description: Prepares a new email bean for compose view, filling in reply/forward/copy as needed.

methods.name: getRequestedUIDs
methods.description: Retrieves UID(s) from request for email actions.

methods.name: getRequestedFlagType
methods.description: Retrieves email flag type from request.

methods.name: getRequestedArgument
methods.description: Safely retrieves a parameter from request array.

methods.name: getInboundEmail
methods.description: Fetches an InboundEmail bean by record ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: setAfterImport
methods.description: Sets bean fields after email import based on request parameters.

methods.name: userIsAllowedToSendEmail
methods.description: Checks if a user has permissions to send email with the specified inbound and outbound accounts.
